mem.10:
**Conversation memory**

- **27 March 2023:** Audrey and Andrew caught up. Andrew had left his old job and started as a financial analyst around 20 March. Audrey had three dogs: Pepper, Precious, and Panda; she enjoys parks and trails with them. Andrew has no pets, likes animals—especially birds—and admires eagles. His favorite hiking spot is Fox Hollow; Audrey said she’d try it.

- **2 April 2023:** Audrey adopted white puppy Pixie, bringing her total to four dogs. Pixie settled in after a few days, and Pepper became especially attached. Audrey had not visited Fox Hollow because the puppy kept her busy. Andrew was considering a dog but struggling to find pet-friendly housing; Audrey suggested housing-site pet filters. They shared dog photos and talked about cuddly companions and hiking.

- **16 April 2023:** Andrew and his girlfriend enjoyed a city café outing with croissants, muffins, and tarts. He missed hiking and nature, which make him feel connected and thriving; city life limited his outdoor time. Audrey said dog walks recharge her and shared homemade blueberry muffins. They planned a pastry party with her dogs. Her dog-and-sunflowers tattoo celebrates her pups and nature, and reminds her of their happy faces when they’re away; Andrew admired it.

- **3 May 2023:** Audrey described a recent hike and a hummingbird with wings spread. Andrew tries to hike weekly; nature feels therapeutic, peaceful, and invigorating, and he takes photos to share calm and positivity. Audrey’s dogs enjoy hikes, sniffing, fetch, and playdates; she uses dog shoes for safety and party hats/treats for fun. She recommended a nearby dog park with trees and benches; Andrew planned to visit.

- **6 May 2023:** Andrew was looking for a dog via websites, shelters, and friends. He shared a photo of a dog behind a cage and thought a small dog might suit apartment life. Finding pet-friendly housing remained hard; he contacted landlords and looked near parks or woods. On **28 April 2023**, Audrey had taken her dogs on a road trip to a national park and shared a photo of three dogs running in grass. She road-trips with them every couple of months. Andrew added a road trip with his future dog to his bucket list and planned another shelter visit.

- **11 May 2023:** Andrew had hiked with friends and his girlfriend the previous weekend, sharing a dirt path toward a grassy hill. Audrey had signed up for a **June positive-reinforcement dog-training class** after seeing a flyer at her pet store and meeting a volunteer’s playful dog. She expected her four dogs to learn quickly with rewards and promised updates and tips for Andrew’s future dog. Both opposed punishment. Andrew would look into classes.

- **2 June 2023:** Audrey said she took her pups to the park on **1 June**, where they ran and played off leash. Andrew shared a sunset-over-mountains photo with a grazing horse. Audrey had recently taken her dogs to a national park, reached a peak at sunset, and described running dogs, breeze, birdsong, and a paradise-like setting. She shared a favorite photo of two horses in a fenced field. Nature cheers her up and makes her grateful. Andrew remained discouraged by the dog/housing search but determined; Audrey offered help if he emailed his criteria.

- **13 June 2023:** Andrew and friends took a rock-climbing class the previous Sunday. He reached the top, felt proud, and was hooked on outdoor activities. He shared a summit view and a man climbing a rock face; friends’ support helped as a beginner. He hoped to do weekly outdoor activities and was considering kayaking and perhaps bungee jumping. Audrey invited him to walk her dogs on a tree-lined park trail; he accepted. She shared dogs playing with a ball and frisbee in a meadow. Walks last about an hour; dogs explore at their own pace and return tired and happy. Both said nature brings peace, joy, calm, refreshment, and perspective.

- **26 June 2023:** Audrey had moved to a new place with a bigger backyard for her dogs, sharing a photo of two dogs on the lawn. She set up an agility/toy play area. Andrew shared a photo of dogs playing at a large indoor doggy daycare near him; Audrey wanted to visit. They agreed pets are family and bring joy, and disliked people who hate or hurt pets. Andrew shared a neighborhood park flower bed. He had hiked with friends the previous Friday, enjoying birdsong and tree smells, but hadn’t reviewed photos yet. Audrey shared a photo of feet resting on a rock above a lake, recalling a peaceful hike there with friends years earlier. They agreed to appreciate small things and not take life for granted.

- **3 July 2023:** Audrey said her dog-training course was challenging but rewarding and her dogs were improving. Andrew still couldn’t find a dog-friendly rental and asked about trails; Audrey had little time for new trails because of the course. She shared a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball. The dogs are all mutts: two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes; Audrey said they are all 3 years old and a great pack. They love running and fetch. They had a doggy playdate the previous Friday, which was chaotic but fun. Photos also showed two dogs curled in a bed and two on a couch under a blanket.

  Andrew had taken up cooking while unable to hike; he finds it fun, relaxing, creative, and stress-relieving, though he’s a rookie. Audrey loves cooking as an escape and creative outlet; she likes music and a glass of wine while cooking and finds it therapeutic/self-care. Her favorite recipe is family Chicken Pot Pie, which reminds her of her grandmother’s kitchen and conversations at the table; she shared pie photos and promised the recipe. Garlic is her go-to ingredient. She also offered her Roasted Chicken recipe, based on Mediterranean flavors—chicken, garlic, lemon, herbs—and described it as healthy, easy, and her favorite comfort meal. Andrew liked the photos, asked for recipes, and promised to report how they turned out.

Pinned facts:
- Audrey's dogs have lots of energy, enjoy meeting other dogs at playdates, and get excited when Audrey brings out a ball or frisbee.
- On April 2, 2023, Andrew said Andrew was considering getting a dog but was finding it challenging to find a dog-friendly place in the city. Audrey said Audrey’s household had used websites with filters for finding places that allow dogs, and that the websites helped them find a suitable place. Andrew said Andrew would try those websites and hoped to find an apartment and a dog.
- On April 2, 2023, Audrey said Pixie took a few days to get used to the other dogs in Audrey’s household, but Pixie now gets along well with them and they play and explore the house together. Audrey also said Pepper initially needed time to adjust to Pixie, but Pepper and Pixie are now always together.
- Andrew said that spending time in nature makes him feel connected, at home in his soul, and restored when life feels chaotic. Andrew misses hiking and the peacefulness of nature, and said city living makes it difficult to get outside and feel that connection.
- On April 2, 2023, Andrew said Andrew missed exploring nature trails with Andrew’s family dog and shared a photo of a man walking a dog on a trail. Andrew said hiking with a dog is fun and helps build bonds and memories; Andrew also shared a photo of a man sitting on a rock with a dog. Audrey said hiking with Audrey’s dogs sounded appealing.
- Audrey says her dogs love walks and that walks are their favorite part of the day; Audrey says their faces brighten when Audrey gets ready to take them out.
- On June 26, 2023, Audrey said Audrey had moved into a new place with a bigger backyard for Audrey’s two dogs. The dogs enjoyed running around and exploring the backyard.
- Audrey is busy caring for her pets and spending time with them, which Audrey finds fulfilling.

Audrey said they bring joy and mean everything to her; Andrew shared a balcony-flower photo. Audrey has a small garden with flowers and a vegetable patch, finds gardening peaceful and fulfilling, and grows Peruvian Lilies, which are easy to care for with water and sun. Her dogs run around and explore the garden; they play only with her own dogs. Photos exchanged included dogs in garden/field, on a dock, sleeping with a teddy bear, and snuggled on a couch.
